Questions & answers

Do I need an API key?

ChatGPT Web lets you sign in with your existing account. No API key needed. For AIChat, use your own credentials for a supported AI provider, or add your own service. Provider subscriptions and usage charges are separate from SwiftChat.

How do I install and update SwiftChat?

Download a published macOS release from GitHub Releases, extract it, and move SwiftChat to Applications. App updates are delivered through the built-in updater. You can also choose Check for Updates from the SwiftChat menu.

Can SwiftChat change text in other apps?

Connected app context is read-only. SwiftChat does not type into or edit a connected app. You can preview the source and choose its available capture scope before sending. Read about app context and privacy.

What do I need to use AIChat tools?

These tools require a model that supports tool calls, with context capacity and maximum output length configured. Text, screenshots, and other tool results can be sent to the model service you select. See support for setup details.
